name: Innocentia
source:
The protagonist's younger sister. She is very close and very attached to her sibling. 
They were both living in an orphanage but, the protagonist having almost reached adulthood, would soon be sent back to the world. Then, they decided to run away together to avoid being separated. 
Since that day they live in the streets.

Brief information:
Symbol: Swan Feather
Best quality: Altruism
Worst quality: Lack of independance
Main fear: Losing her family
The most important thing in life: Family
Flower: Daisy
Musical instrument: Flute

"There is nothing more important than family in the world. I realized it, even though I never had a real one".

[From in-game character profile]
